text_block_list.text:
While looking for Grass Wonder,
who hadn't shown up even though it was time for training—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Take a look at this book.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It was always checked out...
but today, I was finally able to read it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It's a wonderful book.
It carefully explains ancient Japanese culture—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Scenery of the four seasons that hasn't faded for a thousand years—
how very elegant~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't you join as well, Trainer?
I'm sure you'll find scenery that suits your tastes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Ah.
I-I am terribly sorry. What was I thinking...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It completely slipped my mind.
I will make sure to be more careful from now on...

She seemed genuinely remorseful, so I told
Grass Wonder that she could take
the rest of the day off.
